name: Winmate Inc.
summary: Winmate Inc. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sales of rugged display equipment and rugged mobile computer in Europe, Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company offers computing artificial intelligence mobile computer, rugged touch laptop and handheld mobile computer, windows and android rugged tablet, and radio gateway; car tablet, windows, and car android computer. It also offers multi-touch, open architecture, chassis type, panel mounting, PoE touch, USB, stainless steel display, outdoor display, rear installation, industrial explosion-proof, rack mount, long industrial display related products.
